_note: The golden copy of every folder, file and default the platform creates or compares against. The platform and CIS.Spec.Management read it from <exe>\MasterData; nothing ever writes there. 'scopes' must equal Contracts\CisDataVersion.h in the build that ships this tree - the build checks. 'revision' changes when a default VALUE changes with the format unchanged.

roots._note: Where data goes when config.json names no path. specDb and result are PER PRODUCT: <root>\<product>.

layout._note: Which part of this tree describes which installed folder.
